text:
marie: Quick ask  we need a one-page pilot gating checklist for Optimize toolkit (batching, prefix/KV cache, quant recs, eval-triggered alerts). Customers should be able to sign off fast.

lee: Keep it Must / Nice-to-have. Musts: 72h baseline telemetry, seeded eval set (>=50), canary plan with auto-revert, documented rollback.

jon: Thresholds proposal: cost improvement >=10% (24h med), p95 latency within +12% of baseline (or SLA), eval pass-rate drop <=2%. Fail conditions page oncall.

anya: Heuristics for recommendations:
- high tail latency + low token reuse -> prioritize batching
- high prefix repeat -> enable prefix/KV cache
- high tokens per request + stable outputs -> suggest quant (8-bit first)

marie: Canary defaults: 5% traffic, min 20m, auto-revert if p95 > baseline*1.2 for 10m or eval drop >1.5% in 1h. Dry-run mode should be available.

lee: UX: console preview modal showing estimated cost delta, expected latency change, reason and confidence (high/med/low). Confidence derived from sample size & prefix ratio.

jon: Metrics to emit: inf.optimize.apply (labels in telemetry), inf.optimize.eval_violation. Also emit recommendation.confidence.

anya: Rollout guardrails: stage quant suggestions (8-bit -> 4-bit opt-in + extra eval window). 4-bit requires explicit customer consent.

canary-bot: checklist-created: pilot-ready template -> includes baseline capture, eval set, canary config.

marie: Timeline: week 0 heuristics+harness, week1 metrics+preview CLI, week2 internal canary, week3 pilot invite. Resource ask: 2 engs x3w, 1 PM. I'll draft PR template with gating checklist and bench notebook.
